memory_candidates.content: When narrowing a task-type routing table to fix content/tool conflation, a purely textual regression grep (e.g. matching a retired 'theorem...latex' co-occurrence anywhere in a line) can produce false positives on legitimate replacement prose that still mentions both terms for clarification. Fix by reordering the sentence so the retired substring pattern no longer spans left-to-right in the same line, rather than weakening the grep or skipping the check.

For manifest keyword_overrides field placement, cslib.manifest.json places the block immediately after routing_agents/routing_agents_hard and before merge_targets; email.manifest.json places it right after dependencies, before provides. When a manifest has no _hard routing variants (like latex/typst), the cslib placement (after routing_agents, before merge_targets) is the closer structural analog to follow for visual consistency across worked examples.
